items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who played Dronsfield Morgan's band most of the time? [INTERVIEWEE] Alfred Williams.

ctx.x: They'd have a meeting right there, rent out their hall to a different organization or give their own dances like that. Now their favorite band during them days used to be Sam Morgan Band at the Sanchez Centers. Just like the Creole people down my way, if you hire any other band, they had better bands than Sam, but everybody could see Sam Morgan Band in my section, you see.
